name: Stemming the Demon Tide
summary: You are asked to stem the demon tide in Dae'gun by slaying Felguard Sentinels. The work may let regrowth begin anew.

sections.title: A New Beginning
sections.body: Dae'gun's Felguard Sentinels are the foes before you. Their number must be diminished before regrowth can begin anew.

faq.q: What do I need to do in Dae'gun?
faq.answer: You are asked to slay Felguard Sentinels in Dae'gun.
You are asked to slay twelve Felguard Sentinels.
The completion text suggests that regrowth may begin anew.

attribution: In-game quest text: Stemming the Demon Tide
